Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks again for offering to host our team for the product demo. We are aiming for Wednesday, Oct 7, and expect ~20–25 attendees (mix of engineers and PMs). Two quick asks before we lock the time:

- Is Suite Alpha still available that day? We were told during the first coordination call it might be reserved for an internal offsite.
- What’s the process for NDAs and visitor badges? We need to confirm whether we can have signers on arrival or should send DocuSign ahead of time.
- Any limits on hardware brought in? We plan to have 3 demo laptops and 1 external router for a private test network.

If Suite Alpha is not available, any equivalent conference room with seating for 25, basic AV (projector + HDMI), and adjacent break space would work. We can be flexible on the time window; preferred start is 10:00am PT.

Thanks — Sara

Hi Sara — great to hear from you.

Quick update after checking facilities: Suite Alpha is undergoing AV maintenance the morning of Oct 7 and won't be available until the afternoon. We have Suite Beta (adjacent wing) reserved today as a tentative alternative — it seats up to 30, has a ceiling projector, two HDMI inputs, and a builtin Zoom room. It also has a small breakout area next door.

Process for NDAs / badges: we prefer DocuSign in advance to speed check-in, but we can accept signed PDFs on arrival for attendees who don't complete DocuSign. I'll send our Site Access Guide and a DocuSign link for the Lumera NDA in a follow-up. For hardware: laptops and a router are fine; please note there is no ethernet at the demo table (we can provide an access point). Any device that needs an IP whitelisted should be arranged with us 48 hours ahead.

Proposed schedule options (PT):
- Option A: 10:00–12:00 in Suite Beta (we can start setup at 9:15)
- Option B: 13:30–15:30 in Suite Alpha (if AV maintenance completes on time)

Can you confirm which option you prefer? If you approve Option A, Kimberly will finalize on-site logistics and I’ll send calendar invites + badge instructions.

Thanks,

— Markus Klein
